diagnosis: The repeated EFF034 critic/integrator loop exposed a compiler compatibility bug: compileRoleFrontier inserted consumed_returns entries directly into a Set. Guide receipts may use structured disposition objects ({ref|path,...}), so later string return paths did not match those object identities. Already-consumed PARTIAL/BOUNDARY returns could therefore resurrect RETURNS_UNCONSUMED/PARTIAL_LOOP roles under new fingerprints.
intervention: Patched scripts/build-fast-allocator.mjs to normalize both legacy string consumed_returns and structured {ref|path} entries before inserting paths into consumedReturns. Extended the existing consumed-partial suppression regression test so full consumption uses structured ref/path objects while the one-consumed case still exercises the legacy string form.
